Capcom Classics Collection Remixed.name: Capcom Classics Collection Remixed
Capcom Classics Collection Remixed.summary: Capcom serves up a collection of classic games in Capcom Classics Collection. You can relive more than 20 classic titles including 1942, Final Fight, Ghosts 'n Goblins, and Commando. The games can be played in either one- or two-player mode. Capcom Classics Collection also includes bonus material, such as remixed soundtracks, game tips, and original artwork.

Kud Wafter - Converted Edition.name: Kud Wafter: Converted Edition
Kud Wafter - Converted Edition.summary: An expanded port of Kud Wafter for consoles, which removes the sexual content and adds additional story events and visuals.

Shirahana no Ori - Hiiro no Kakera 4.name: Shirahana no Ori - Hiiro no Kakera 4
Shirahana no Ori - Hiiro no Kakera 4.summary: A visual novel developped by Otomate and the prequel of the first Hiiro no Kakera.

Umihara Kawase Portable.name: Umihara Kawase Portable
Umihara Kawase Portable.summary: A port of Umihara Kawase Shun for the PlayStation Portable released only in Japan.

World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014 - Aoki.name: World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014: Aoki Samurai no Chousen
World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014 - Aoki.summary: A Japan-exclusive port of Pro Evolution Soccer 2014. This version centers on career progression with the Japan national team, offering modes that guide players through international competition and national representation.
